source: CAMIL GE-V-16 · Page 31 · Transportation (car parts half)
notes: HEAD-LIGHT and TAIL-LIGHT normalised to 'headlight' and 'taillight'.
engine/motor (motor) is a collision pair and stays together.
'trunk' now appears in three areas — the body, swim trunks and a car boot. Different
areas, so no exercise can put them together, but it is the same word taught three ways.
EASY: mechanical vocabulary is a step up from naming objects around a house.
